Reduce amdgpu.vgpr by at least 24 registers/subgroup (to at most 216) and amdgpu.lds by at least 18,944 bytes/workgroup (to at most 43,008) together; reducing only one leaves another limiter. Recompile and benchmark the modeled transition 6 -> 7 subgroups/SIMD; higher modeled residency is not a throughput guarantee.

guidance: Static compiler findings; order and confidence do not rank performance benefit. Optimization requires a known-good oracle's native instruction mix, controlled measurement on the intended machine, and data reuse policy, plus an end-to-end opportunity bound. An unexplained large oracle gap stops local tuning; small gains over our own baseline do not qualify the execution shape.
